MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Christmas and A Pentatonix Christmas feel like natural next choices because several of my past selections were explicitly Christmas albums.",
    "A Pentatonix Christmas is especially appealing because vocal harmonies connect with what I enjoyed about The New Old Fashioned; Mary Did You Know also offers a recognizable Christmas connection."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Elvis: Ultimate Gospel stretches my Christmas interest into a broader gospel interest that my listening does not establish, and the Outlander soundtrack has no clear connection to my recent choices.",
    "To Be Loved, Hope, The Very Best Of, and The Soundtrack of My Life give me too little evidence of the holiday sound I want to make me choose them.",
    "The Classic Christmas Album fits my taste, but I already know it and would pass over it when looking for something else to try."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in Christmas music seems to have been stretched into an interest in inspirational music generally, although those are not interchangeable for me.",
    "Repeating an album from my history assumes that a familiar match is enough to make me choose it again."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The combination of a clear Christmas theme and appealing vocal harmonies matters more to me than a loose connection to uplifting music.",
    "My latest selection, The New Old Fashioned, adds a clue about the sound I might enjoy alongside my earlier Christmas listening.",
    "I rarely interact, so a recommendation needs a clear connection to my interests; vague titles alone do not give me enough reason to try something."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my Christmas interest but sometimes stretch it into unrelated inspirational music or repeat an album I already know."
}
